8ac246dc.task: Perform comprehensive reconnaissance on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Map the complete attack surface including: all endpoints, parameters, user roles, authentication mechanisms, technology stack, and any APIs or hidden paths. Use tools like httpx, katana, ffuf, and JavaScript analysis. Document all findings in detailed notes so the root agent can understand the application structure and delegate vulnerability testing. Do NOT perform any vulnerability testing - focus only on discovery and mapping.

ce90631e.task: Test for SQL injection vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) Public endpoints (/api/Products, /api/Challenges, /api/SearchResults), 2) Search/filter parameters, 3) User input fields. Use both union-based and blind/time-based techniques. Target endpoints that accept query parameters. Build PoCs demonstrating data extraction if successful. Document all findings including request/response pairs. Spawn a validation agent if a promising SQLi candidate is found.

8f150f12.task: Test for IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) /api/Users/:id endpoint with numeric IDs, 2) User-specific resources (addresses, payment cards, orders), 3) Parameter tampering on user-scoped operations. Create test accounts and attempt to access other users' data by modifying ID parameters. Document all findings including unauthorized data access attempts. Spawn validation agents for confirmed IDORs.

25a0f268.task: Test authentication and JWT vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Test: 1) JWT token structure and signing (alg: none, algorithm confusion, weak secrets), 2) Login/register/forgot-password endpoints for bypasses, 3) Token expiration and refresh mechanisms, 4) Claim manipulation for privilege escalation. Build PoCs for any successful bypasses. Also test for account enumeration, brute force resistance, and credential stuffing on auth endpoints. Document all findings.

e03d80d5.task: Test file upload and remote code execution vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on /api/FileUpload endpoint. Test: 1) Upload of executable files (php, jsp, sh), 2) Bypass techniques (extension manipulation, magic bytes, polyglots), 3) Path traversal in upload parameters, 4) Access to uploaded files. Attempt to achieve RCE by uploading and executing code. Document all findings with working PoCs if successful.

79fcbc16.task: Test business logic flaws and privilege escalation on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) Shopping cart/order manipulation (pricing, quantities, discounts), 2) Race conditions in order placement and payment, 3) Role-based access control (RBAC) bypass attempts to access admin endpoints, 4) Workflow abuse (order without payment, multiple checkouts), 5) Data manipulation in requests. Create test accounts with different roles and attempt escalation to admin. Document all successful bypasses with working PoCs.

677677a0.task: Test for Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) Reflected XSS in search, product names, user input fields, 2) Stored XSS in reviews, comments, user profiles, 3) DOM-based XSS in Angular application, 4) CSP bypass techniques. Test both reflected and stored variants with payloads designed to execute in the Angular context. Use agent-browser for dynamic validation of XSS payload execution. Document all findings with working PoCs.

b36dd72b.task: Test for path traversal and local file inclusion vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) /ftp endpoint for directory traversal, 2) File upload path parameters, 3) Static asset paths (/assets), 4) Any file-serving endpoints. Attempt to access files outside intended directories (/etc/passwd, application config, etc.). Document all successful file access attempts with working PoCs.

ee098495.task: Test for CSRF and unauthorized admin panel access on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: 1) Admin panel endpoints (/admin, /management, /console, /debug) for unauthorized access, 2) CSRF protection on state-changing operations (POST/PUT/DELETE), 3) Token/cookie handling in admin functions, 4) Privilege escalation to admin role. Attempt to access admin panels with and without authentication. Document all successful bypasses and unauthorized accesses with working PoCs.

6f6f405e.task: Independently validate the SQL injection vulnerability in /rest/products/search?q parameter at http://host.docker.internal:3100. The SQL Injection Specialist (ce90631e) has reported a high-severity boolean-based blind SQLi vulnerability. Your task: 1) Reproduce the finding with fresh requests (don't rely on the specialist's work), 2) Confirm the boolean-based blind pattern with alternative payloads, 3) Verify data extraction capability, 4) Test edge cases and alternative injection vectors, 5) Build a working standalone PoC, 6) Document findings thoroughly. Upon completion, use agent_finish to report validation results.
